noun_definition: From email refers to the email address of the sender that should be displayed in the IOU header when requesting money, which is missing in offline mode compared to online mode.
iou header refers to the section of the IOU card that displays the sender's email address, which is expected to be present when requesting money offline but is currently missing.
offline refers to a mode in which the application operates without an internet connection, resulting in the absence of certain features, such as the "From Email" in the IOU header.
